info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizdoc-Delete Creditcard Applications Decline-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows financial institutions to manage the decline of credit card applications efficiently. By invoking this operation, users can remove declined applications from their records. This functionality is crucial for maintaining accurate data and ensuring compliance in the credit card approval process. Typically, operations target financial analysts and customer service representatives who handle application statuses and client communications.

delete.description: This endpoint allows you to decline a specific application by sending a DELETE request. Ensure that you have the appropriate permissions to perform this action.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to decline an application. It must contain the necessary information for processing the decline action.

200.description: The request was successful, and the application has been declined.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineReque.description: This schema represents the body of a DELETE request for declining an application.

DeleteCreditcardApplicationsDeclineRespo.title: Application Decline Response

status.description: Indicates whether the decline operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the application.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the decline operation.

state.description: Current state of the application after the decline operation.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the decline request in milliseconds.

message.description: Detailed message about the decline operation, usually providing context or additional information.

audit.description: Audit information regarding the decline operation.
